review.note: Bee species for most resources, including metals, plus hives, nests, feeders and the machines around them. Many species are compat bees for mods not in the pack, so whether a given bee is active is unverified. Powered: honey generator makes FE; powered and heated centrifuge, breeding chamber and incubator use FE; the plain centrifuge does not. Built-in support: AE2, Ars Nouveau, Create, Draconic Evolution, Flux Networks, Mekanism, Mystical Agriculture, Occultism, Powah, Silent Gear and others. Yield data: yields/productivebees.json (species names only, outputs unverified).
